_doc: Maintenance requests executed by .github/workflows/ops.yml when this file changes on main. Each request runs once; keep the list as a log.

close_issues.comment: Cause: pace.py imported pandas in the stdlib-only snapshot job (runaway loop 2026-09-30, no CND requests). Fixed in c87ffab; chain bugs fixed in 1c29091 and 7874b1f. Closing.

irregular_step = the source occasionally skips one minute label in the trend (e.g. 08:20 -> 08:22). Harmless: other fetches hold the minute and the gap report shows 100% coverage. Now logged without alerting (BENIGN_DRIFT_KINDS). Closing.

CND's SITR returned HTTP 500 on every endpoint from 2026-10-08 04:41 to 12:14 UTC (source outage). Capture resumed automatically; the trend has no missing minutes (later fetches covered the window). This alert now closes itself after the first fully successful fetch; the pipeline also stops retrying for the rest of a cycle once an endpoint fails hard. Closing.

Not drift: from 2026-10-12 04:51 to 15:00 UTC CND published empty strings for every Demanda Pronosticada value (123 fetches). Generation and real demand were unaffected, and the forecast minutes were filled by other fetches: per-series coverage is 100%. Empty values are now logged as 'empty_values' without alerting; the gap report (now per series) is the real check. Closing.
